title: Label a structured status
prompt: A Reading has an id, a name, and a state. Return "id:name:queued", "id:name:running", or "id:name:done". Use the enum value; do not modify the record.

tests.label: Queued
tests.hint: This is the starter’s only correct state.

tests.label: Empty name preserved
tests.hint: Formatting preserves data even when the name is empty.

hints: A struct groups the id, name, and state.
A switch handles each enum class member by name.
explanation: The enum limits the set of intended states. The formatting function borrows the record as a const reference and creates an owned string.
chapterTitle: Modeling Structured Data with Structures and Enumerations
